recent_news.headline: National Restaurant Association Show begins at McCormick Place in Chicago
recent_news.summary: 105th annual National Restaurant Association Show kicks off with 53,000+ foodservice professionals from 100 countries and 2,000+ vendors. The industry gathers to explore solutions for labor shortages, cost pressures, and technology innovations.

recent_news.headline: Restaurant industry navigates 'complex' consumer landscape as sentiment hits all-time low
recent_news.summary: Analysis of challenging consumer sentiment and spending patterns impacting restaurant operators in May 2026.

recent_news.headline: Innovation and cultural relevance drove the success for many burger chains
recent_news.summary: Analysis of burger chain performance and strategies for success in 2025.

recent_news.headline: Innovation was not the key to success among chicken chains in 2025
recent_news.summary: Industry analysis showing chicken chains succeeded on factors other than menu innovation.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Announces Acquisition of Terra Nova Solutions
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors announced a $225 million acquisition of Terra Nova Solutions, a regional provider of hazardous and non-hazardous waste solutions based in the Carolinas. The deal adds five sites supporting high-margin recurring revenue streams including wastewater treatment and waste processing, with expected ~$4 million in annual synergies.

recent_news.headline: Truck Driver Shortage 2026: Impact on Shippers
recent_news.summary: A federal rule effective March 2026 prohibits asylum seekers, refugees, and DACA recipients from obtaining CDLs, shrinking the available driver pool. Foreign-born drivers account for nearly one in six truckers, and small fleets are disproportionately affected by regulatory changes.

backfill_news.headline: Restaurant job growth was choppy in recent months but trendline continues positive
backfill_news.summary: May 2026 report showing restaurants added 17,200 jobs in April but faced losses in February. Employment remains 71,400 jobs above pre-pandemic levels but full-service segment still 193,000 jobs below Feb 2020 peak.

backfill_news.headline: US Restaurant Industry 2026 Expectations Breakdown
backfill_news.summary: Analysis of 2026 restaurant outlook with sales growth projections, margin pressures from labor and food costs, and performance expectations for major chains like Darden and Texas Roadhouse.
